proofOfCompleteness.rawOcrWords: raw/<run>/<caseId>.words.jsonl carries one record per OcrWord for every pass, and the acquisition asserts emittedWordCount === extractionDebug.passes[i].words.length for every pass. Any inequality halts with RAW_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED. No sampleWords cap, no first-25 cap and no 120-character text truncation is applied, because the evidence is read from extractionDebug rather than from the capped CaseReport projection.
proofOfCompleteness.candidateDecisions: raw/<run>/<caseId>.candidates.jsonl carries one record per BrandCandidateDiagnostic, kept AND rejected, and the acquisition asserts emittedCandidateCount === brandDiagnostics.candidates.length read before any projection. Any inequality halts with CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED. The prohibited filter(kept && ranking).slice(0, 6) projection is not used and the cap is not merely raised.

layout.raw/<run>/<caseId>.passes.json: one record per OCR pass: identity, role, crop and transform, engine configuration, timings, warnings, errors, pass fingerprint
layout.raw/<run>/<caseId>.words.jsonl: one record per OCR word, in original order, across every pass
layout.raw/<run>/<caseId>.lines.jsonl: one record per reconstructed Brand line, in emitted order
layout.raw/<run>/<caseId>.candidates.jsonl: one record per Brand candidate decision, kept and rejected
layout.raw/<run>/<caseId>.selection.json: final selected value, authority state, abstention reason, ranked order over the complete list

immutabilityRule: After a run's raw-evidence-manifest.sha256 is written, no file under raw/<run>/ is rewritten, reformatted or pretty-printed. JSONL is emitted in final form and is excluded from prettier via .prettierignore.
truthIsolationAssertion: Before each manifest is written, every emitted file is scanned for the forbidden field names and for any governed acceptable-value string. A hit halts with TRUTH_ISOLATION_FAILURE.
knownGapsCarriedFromTheContracts: every individual filter check and every active rejection reason per candidate — the ladder short-circuits, so only the first firing reason exists
word baseline geometry and block/paragraph/line identifiers — not present on OcrWord
constituent word IDs per reconstructed line — not emitted by BrandLineDiagnostic
line bounding boxes — only prominence is emitted
